Expert guidance for Python in n8n Code nodes.

Use JavaScript for 95% of use cases: HTTP (`$helpers.httpRequest`), dates (Luxon), most transformations, and when in doubt. Python has no external libraries; use it for Python-specific logic, standard-library features, or existing Python code.

Data access: `_input.all()`, `_input.first()`, `_input.item` (Each Item mode only), `_node["NodeName"]`. Webhook data is under `["body"]`: `_input.first()["json"].get("body", {})`.

Standard library: `json`, `datetime`, `re`, `base64`, `hashlib`, `urllib.parse`, `math`, `random`, `statistics`.

Must return `[{"json": {...}}]`. Use `.get()` for dictionary access to avoid `KeyError`; check lengths before indexing to avoid `IndexError`. Handle empty input (`if items:`). Test both modes (All Items and Each Item). Return items in `[{"json": {...}}]` format.

Do not import external libraries: `requests`, `pandas`, and `numpy` cause `ModuleNotFoundError`. Use HTTP Request or JavaScript for HTTP; list comprehensions and standard library instead of pandas/numpy; n8n database nodes (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB) instead of database drivers; HTML Extract instead of BeautifulSoup or Selenium.
